description:
Hey friends! I had an idea. Inspired by many of your comments about putting my videos on in the background (to cook... clean... or even to fall asleep to), I decided to create something just for you.

This is a Murder, Mystery & Makeup Compilation... over 3 hours long... featuring the stories where some teenagers just completely snapped. It still makes my head spin how someone so young and seemingly harmless could be capable of such horrific violence.

From greedy motives to cult influences, this collection dives deep into the why and how young, impressionable minds can become a very dangerous thing.

Sweet dreams! lol

xo
Bailey
